title: 功率模組雙面散熱
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入雙面散熱熱阻分配、電氣隔離與機械約束；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine double-sided heat sharing, isolation and mechanical constraint. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。兩支路並聯公式假設相同參考溫度及集中熱源；不對稱流體溫度和空間熱點需用完整網路。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Parallel resistance assumes equal reference temperatures and a lumped source; unequal coolants and hotspots need a full network.
